Scenario: the full scan blocks a token written into an Authorization header

g.text: Given a generated project calls an API with a token written into its Authorization header
A project generated from the toolbox. src/client.js calls an API with a made-up 32-character token in its Authorization
header, after the word Bearer, the way the developer would paste it from the API's settings page.
When the developer runs the full secret scan, it blocks the token in the Authorization
The full scan reads every file of the project. It finds the token in src/client.js, line 2, under the rule
bearer-token-hardcoded, prints "REDACTED" where the value was, and fails: "❌ Betterleaks detected secrets in your
